Annotated disassembly of the function containing an address.

Usage

xref asm [OPTIONS] [ADDR]

Arguments and options

Arguments

[ADDR]
An address inside the function; optional with --from, whose function is used.

Options

--from <FROM>
First address to print.
--to <TO>
End address (exclusive).

Examples

All examples were recorded on public binaries; see Provenance.

Reading the output

  • The first line is the function range from .eh_frame.
  • Each line is one instruction: address, Intel-syntax text, and after ; the resolved target or referenced data (string previews, pointer slots, call targets).
  • --from / --to print a part of the function; the annotations stay the same. With --from the function address can be left out: xref asm --from 0x1200 --to 0x1240 prints that part of the function containing 0x1200.

Limits

  • Annotation is static: values loaded at run time and indirect targets are not resolved.

Provenance

Recorded with a development build of xref after 0.5.0 (commit c5cf554, PR #189) on Linux x86-64, on xref.stripped = a stripped xref build (the binary of the home-page examples). Output is unchanged except that whitespace at the end of each line and empty lines at the end of the output are removed; long outputs are cut where marked.
